text: The future of AI is a popular topic today. Most AI systems we use now are narrow, meaning they are designed for one specific task. However, many experts are working on general AI, or AGI, which would be able to think and learn like a human across many different areas. This could bring great benefits, such as solving difficult problems in medicine and science. At the same time, there are serious risks, including job losses and safety concerns. Experts disagree about when AGI might arrive. Some predict it within ten years, while others believe it is still far away.
